answer: EigenTrust centrality is computed from trusted endorsements, weighted by reciprocity and transitive paths, while reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life. A new identity therefore starts near zero eigenvector centrality; it must provide sustained honest service to build durable influence. A sybil cannot manufacture a haven or oasis of trust through identity creation alone, reach the network’s zenith, or pass consensus without credible support from established peers.
